correctness.rationale: Translation gives a unique normalized tuple with minimum 0. Every candidate of diameter at most 45 is among the binomial(45,5)=1,221,759 tuples, and no tuple beyond that bound can improve any tabulated minimum. Independent exhaustive replay counts distinct repeated-summand triples by a batched Boolean incidence array. It reproduces all 40 minima against RESULT.md, separately checks every profile.tsv witness, and returns only {0,2,11,26,42,45} and {0,3,19,34,43,45} at the minimum for 56. In particular m(40)=15 and m(41)=14. Rajagopal's Theorem 1.7, not the finite search, establishes the global exclusion of 17. The endpoint 45 is forced by size 56 and sufficient for every case; Nathanson's [0,N-1] convention makes the length 46.
residual_risks: This is a finite optimization certificate for (3,6) relying on the cited theorem for the global range, not a general diameter bound or formal verification.
